### RF 3Q26: Steady compounder; credit and fees better

**Headline:** GAAP diluted EPS was $0.71, up from $0.64 in 2Q26. This note focuses on **adjusted EPS of $0.73**, up from $0.68 (+7%), a beat versus the prior quarter. The only adjustment is $15m pre-tax ($11m after tax) of securities repositioning losses, about $0.02/share, versus $45m of adjustments in 2Q26.

**EPS drivers (underlying):** Adjusted revenue rose 2% to $1,988m, adjusted expense was flat at $1,118m, and provision was flat at $68m. The tax rate eased to 19.8% from 20.7%.

**Revenue and margin:** NII rose 1.6% to $1,298m. Drivers were fixed-rate asset turnover, loan growth, hedging income, credit interest recoveries and an extra day. FTE NIM rose 2bp to 3.68%, with interest-bearing deposit costs at 1.70%. Adjusted fees rose 3% to $690m: record capital markets (+27% to $107m), record treasury management, and commercial credit fees +25%. Wealth eased after a record 2Q. Reported efficiency was 56.2% (adjusted 55.8%).

**Credit:** NCOs fell to $72m (29bp) from 42bp. NPLs fell 8bp to 0.59% of loans and business criticized loans fell to 4.71%. ACL/loans eased 2bp to 1.61%, with NPL coverage at 275%.

**Capital and returns:** CET1 rose to 10.8% (est.). RF bought back $95m and declared $255m of dividends. TBV/share fell to $12.65 from $13.78 on AOCI. ROTCE was 21.3% reported and 21.7% adjusted.

**Guidance:** For 4Q26: NII +1-2%, NIM ~3.70%, capital markets $90-105m (below 3Q's record). FY26 NCOs are guided at 40-50bp, trending to the low end. FY adjusted expense +1.5-3.5%, with positive adjusted operating leverage.

**Thesis:** Reinforces it. Peer-leading deposit costs, a hedged NIM and improving credit support best-in-class returns. Soft deposit balances are the minor watch item.
